title: SharePoint: eSignature recipient groups let any one of up to 10 people sign for a slot
summary: Hold: the external-signing question incorrectly treats Conditional Access exceptions as a requirement for individual recipients. Microsoft describes exceptions as a possible remedy in some configurations, not a universal prerequisite. The roadmap facts, published eSignature price and listed control paths are supported.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits an on-by-default, metered change targeted within about 60 days that needs a signing-process decision.
